summary: Route every generated command's HTML extraction through crestronExtract instead of calling extractHTMLResponse directly.
reason: Crestron.com serves server-rendered ASP.NET/Kentico HTML with no JSON API, so the generic extractHTMLResponse returns unusable flattened text for all 12 endpoints. crestronExtract dispatches to the domain parsers in internal/crestronparse and falls back to extractHTMLResponse when no parser matches. Without this one-line swap in each generated command, no Crestron command parses correctly. The generator has no post-extract hook for HTML responses, so the call-site swap is the only available seam.
validated_outcome: Full live dogfood at publish time: 111 passed, 0 failed across 195 checks against www.crestron.com.
